generation.explanation: Slice the cone and cylinder at the same distance from the cone’s tip. At a fraction u of the total height, similar triangles give the cone a radius u times the base radius, so its slice has u² times the cylinder’s slice area. Adding all these slices gives Vcone/Vcylinder = ∫₀¹ u² du = 1/3. Drag the yellow slice to see how its radius and area change.
